root.name: ハワイアン・エレクトリック

rows.ja: 電力の購入先(独立系発電)

companies.name: パー・パシフィック(パー・ハワイ)

relations.text: 発電用の燃料を供給(2023年から)
relations.text_en: Supplies fuel for its power plants (since 2023)

source.label: Hawaiian Electric 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On February 1, 2022, the Utilities and PAR Hawaii Refining, LLC (PAR Hawaii) entered into a fuel supply contract (Supply Agreement) commencing January 1, 2023.

companies.name: パシフィック・バイオディーゼル

relations.text: 全島の発電所にバイオディーゼルを供給

source.label: Hawaiian Electric 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On December 13, 2021, the Utilities and PBT signed an agreement for supply of biodiesel on all islands commencing January 1, 2023, which was approved by the PUC on December 1, 2022.

source.label: Hawaiian Electric 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Utilities are taking additional measures to ensure adequate supply of fuel by entering into a backup fuel supply contract with Vitol Inc. (Vitol) commencing on December 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023, with annual extensions if mutually agreed by both parties.

companies.name: REGマーケティング&ロジスティクス

relations.text: オアフ島向けバイオディーゼルの予備供給

source.label: Hawaiian Electric 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Hawaiian Electric has a contingency supply contract with REG Marketing & Logistics Group, LLC to also supply biodiesel to any generating unit on Oahu in the event PBT is not able to supply necessary quantities.

companies.name: カラエロア・パートナーズ

relations.text_en: Hawaiian Electric buys 208 MW of firm capacity from it

source.label: Hawaiian Electric 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Under the 2021 Amended and Restated PPA with Kalaeloa Partners, L.P. (Kalaeloa), Hawaiian Electric is committed to purchase 208 MW of firm capacity.

relations.text: ハワイ島で地熱の電力34.6MWを購入
relations.text_en: Buys 34.6 MW of geothermal power on Hawaii Island

source.label: Hawaiian Electric 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Hawaii Electric Light has a 35-year PPA, as amended, with Puna Geothermal Venture (PGV) for 34.6 MW of firm capacity from its geothermal steam facility, which will expire on December 31, 2027.

relations.text: ハワイ島で電力を購入する契約(PPA)
relations.text_en: Power purchase agreement on Hawaii Island

source.label: Hawaiian Electric 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the Utilities are deemed to have a variable interest in Kalaeloa Partners, L.P. (Kalaeloa) and Hamakua Energy by reason of the provisions of the PPA that the Utilities have with the two IPPs.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
